name: University of Cambridge
typicalOffer: A*A*A, Mathematics plus 2 other science or mathematics subjects (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and for A level only Further Mathematics); some Colleges/first-year options need specific sciences
notes: Natural Sciences (Physical) with theoretical stream; DAMTP — world-leading theoretical group; Part III Mathematical Tripos follows

name: Imperial College London
typicalOffer: A*A*A, A* in Mathematics; A* in Physics; A in another subject (Further Mathematics recommended but not essential)
notes: 4-year MPhys Theoretical Physics; string theory, QFT and quantum gravity research at Blackett Laboratory

name: Durham University
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including Physics and Mathematics; science A levels with a practical component require the practical to be passed
notes: 4-year MPhys Theoretical Physics; Institute for Particle Physics Phenomenology; Ogden Centre for Fundamental Physics; strong QFT group

name: University of Edinburgh
typicalOffer: AAA-ABB, including Mathematics at A and Physics at B
notes: 4-year MPhys Theoretical Physics; Higgs Centre for Theoretical Physics — Peter Higgs was an Edinburgh professor; strong QFT research

name: University of Manchester
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including A* in Physics and A* in Mathematics or Further Mathematics
notes: 4-year MPhys Theoretical Physics; strong particle theory group; LHC data analysis; Jodrell Bank cosmological research links

name: University of Nottingham
typicalOffer: AAA, Including AA in A level maths and physics
notes: 4-year MPhys Theoretical Physics; quantum information and gravity research; joint with Mathematical Sciences School
courseName: Physics with Theoretical Physics MSci Hons

name: University of Birmingham
typicalOffer: A*A*A or A*AAA, including Mathematics and Physics (A*A*A route needs A* in both; other routes listed on the page)
notes: 4-year MPhys Theoretical Physics; quantum gravity and black hole physics research; joint with Mathematical Sciences

name: University of Southampton
typicalOffer: AAA, including Mathematics and Physics (grade A)
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: University of York
notes: 4-year MPhys Theoretical Physics; York Centre for Quantum Technologies; string theory and quantum information research

name: University of Sussex
typicalOffer: ABB, A-levels must include Mathematics grade B; Physics A-level desirable but not required
notes: 4-year MPhys Theoretical Physics; historically strong — Abdus Salam (Nobel 1979) worked here; Sussex Centre for Quantum Technologies

name: University of Liverpool
typicalOffer: ABB, including Mathematics A level at grade A and Physics A level at grade B
notes: 4-year MPhys Theoretical Physics; Cockcroft Institute partnership; strong high-energy theory group; quantum field theory and phenomenology
